class.name: NetwDatabaseConfig
class.brief_description: The configuration of a named [NetwDatabase], returned by [method Netw.configure_database].
class.description: Sets the [NetwDatabaseBackend] a database opens. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_database(self, &"saves").backend(preload("res://save_backend.tres")) [/codeblock] Configuring the same name twice in one session with a different backend is refused.

method.name: backend
method.description: Sets the storage this database opens, and returns this config.

members.member: The storage this database opens, as [method backend] set it.
